text.en:
The term of the Presidential Committee to Study Government Corporations (PCSGC) is extended up to
June 30, 1979 and it is further directed that the Committee submit its report to the President/Prime Minister on
or before said date.

An appropriation of P300,000 is authorized for the use of the Committee for the period January 1,
1979 to June 30, 1979, in addition to whatever unexpended balance it may have out of its existing
appropriations as of September 30, 1978.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
